description: Source code for the SqlTranslator class responsible for translating SQL statement objects into SQL query strings, including handling of CTEs, joins, clauses, and expressions within the OrchardCore project.

classes.name: SqlTranslator
classes.description: A class that converts SQL statement objects into SQL query strings, managing clauses, expressions, and dialect-specific rendering.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Main method to translate a StatementList object into a SQL query string.

methods.name: CollectAliasesAndCtes
methods.description: Collects table aliases and CTE names from the statement list.

methods.name: CollectTableAliases
methods.description: Collects table aliases from a SelectStatement.

methods.name: TranslateStatementLine
methods.description: Translates each statement line, including union statements.

methods.name: TranslateUnionStatement
methods.description: Translates a union statement, including WITH clause and SELECT statement.

methods.name: TranslateWithClause
methods.description: Translates a WITH clause with CTEs.

methods.name: TranslateSelectStatement
methods.description: Translates a SelectStatement into SQL string, handling clauses like SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, etc.

methods.name: TranslateColumnItemList
methods.description: Translates list of column items, handling SELECT * case.

methods.name: TranslateColumnItem
methods.description: Translates a single column item, including alias.

methods.name: TranslateColumnSource
methods.description: Translates column source expressions.

methods.name: TranslateOverClause
methods.description: Translates OVER clause for window functions.

methods.name: TranslateFromClause
methods.description: Translates FROM clause with table sources and joins.

methods.name: TranslateTableSource
methods.description: Translates individual table sources, including subqueries.

methods.name: TranslateJoinStatement
methods.description: Translates JOIN statements.

methods.name: TranslateGroupByClause
methods.description: Translates GROUP BY clause.

methods.name: TranslateOrderByClause
methods.description: Translates ORDER BY clause.

methods.name: TranslateOrderByList
methods.description: Translates list of ORDER BY items.

methods.name: TranslateExpression
methods.description: Translates various expression types into SQL syntax.

methods.name: TranslateBinaryExpression
methods.description: Translates binary expressions.

methods.name: GetBinaryOperatorString
methods.description: Returns SQL string for binary operators.

methods.name: TranslateUnaryExpression
methods.description: Translates unary expressions.

methods.name: GetUnaryOperatorString
methods.description: Returns SQL string for unary operators.

methods.name: TranslateBetweenExpression
methods.description: Translates BETWEEN expressions.

methods.name: TranslateInExpression
methods.description: Translates IN expressions.

methods.name: TranslateTupleExpression
methods.description: Translates tuple expressions.

methods.name: TranslateParenthesizedSelectStatement
methods.description: Translates parenthesized SELECT statements.

methods.name: TranslateParameterExpression
methods.description: Translates parameter expressions, handling default values.

methods.name: ExtractLiteralValue
methods.description: Extracts literal value from expression for default parameters.

methods.name: TranslateFunctionCall
methods.description: Translates function call expressions.

methods.name: TranslateFunctionArguments
methods.description: Converts function arguments into string array.

methods.name: TranslateSelectStatementToString
methods.description: Converts a SelectStatement into string using a temporary builder.

methods.name: TranslateExpressionListToArray
methods.description: Converts list of expressions into array of strings.

methods.name: TranslateIdentifierInSelectContext
methods.description: Translates identifiers in SELECT context, handling table prefixes and aliases.

methods.name: TranslateIdentifierInFromContext
methods.description: Translates identifiers in FROM context, handling table prefixes and CTEs.
